ov: A small, striped marsupial and the only marsupial fully active by day. It eats almost nothing but termites, licking them up with a long, sticky tongue. Once widespread across southern Australia, it is now endangered and survives in a few small colonies.
rg: Small colonies in Western Australia, plus fenced reserves in South Australia and New South Wales.
df: Almost exclusively termites, up to 20,000 a day.
fx: It is the faunal emblem of Western Australia.
It has the sharpest eyesight of any marsupial.
notes: RESOLVED (owner approved all suggestions, 2026-09-29): ANSWER CHECK (fact): "Eats up to 20,000 termites a day and nothing else" is half sourced: 20,000 a day is confirmed, but the article says "almost exclusively" termites.
